text: **A.** Response B runs to about 139 words, clearly breaking the 120-word limit, which is the request's one hard constraint. Response A comes to about 125 words with labels and title, or about 115 without the title. It stays within or very close to the limit and still covers every key change: office days, exceptions, excluded teams, equipment, hot desking and the rationale. B adds minor details (lockers, existing equipment kept, the Q&A pointer), but these do not justify exceeding the limit for a busy reader.
